statements.status_notes: ZooKeeper is used only by the optional HBase/distributed storage backends via Apache Curator; not loaded by the default gremlin-server. Upgrading past 3.9.2 breaks reactor dependency convergence (slf4j 2.x); reachability assessment pending.
Zookeeper is bundled transitively by the optional Hadoop/Spark OLAP backend; not exercised by the default gremlin-server. The flagged copy is pinned by the backend; reachability assessment pending.
